It is hosted by Lulu Miller and Latif Nasser.

title: The Harbingers
description:
Adam Blackwell and Amy Stirling met as graduate students in anthropology, both obsessed with studying the same dead language and long-lost culture. Their relationship was always... complicated. They were bitter rivals, ideological opposites, and even went out on a date once — though they’d really prefer if everyone forgot about that last thing, thank you very much.

Then, they became the first two people in thousands of years capable of doing magic.
  
Over the next five years, they became global superstars, both revered and feared. Their powers led to a tragedy unlike any the world had seen before. Now, the world's first two magicians of the modern age must figure out the truth of their power, its consequences, and their relationship with one another before they do more damage to the world.
  
The Harbingers is a new fiction podcast created by Gabriel Urbina, directed and sound designed by Jeffrey Nils Gardner.
  
From Audacious Machine Creative.

description:
Calma Urgente! 
Alessandra Orofino, Bruno Torturra e Gregorio Duvivier discutem os assuntos que urgem serem tratados com muita calma. 

Toda segunda-feira ao vivo às 20h30 no YouTube do Estúdio Fluxo. 
E toda quarta-feira de manhã em podcast.

Faça parte do Clube de Cultura do Calma Urgente 2026, conversas semanais sobre livros, filmes, séries e discos com Alê, Bruno, Greg e convidados especiais.

Our theme and end credit music is composed by Sam Tyndall.

For hobbyist gamers, this podcast will help you to explore your own tastes in the hobby and perhaps discover your next favorite game that fits those tastes. title: CheapShow
description:
CheapShow is a comedy podcast all about getting the very best out of the worst! Be it Poundlands, Charity Shops, Car Boot Sales or Bargain Bins, hosts Paul Gannon & Eli Silverman poke around in the corners of the high streets and internet to find treasure in the trash.

One week it could be a studio based show, the next, a live comedy event. It could even be a location report or a scripted adventure! A few things it is, however, is rude, crude, silly and drizzled in pop culture, nostalgia and plenty of verbal violence!

It has guests, videos, songs, reviews, games and dares. We apologise in advance!
www.thecheapshow.co.uk

title: Gyncast – der Gynäkologie-Podcast
description:
Der Gyncast ist eure ganz persönliche Gynäkologie-Sprechstunde. Egal ob Dating trotz Vaginalpilz, Schwangerschaft mit 66 oder wie der Zyklus beim Bergsteigen hilft: In jeder Folge sprechen wir mit einem Gast über ihre medizinische Geschichte und lernen, wie unsere Körper ticken.

Chefärztin Prof. Dr. Mandy Mangler und Tagesspiegel-Redakteurin Esther Kogelboom begleiten euch bei euren gynäkologischen Problemen: wissenschaftlich fundiert, klischeefrei und selbstermächtigend. Jeden Donnerstag hört ihr hier eine neue Folge.

Ihr wollt auch Gast im Gyncast sein? Dann schreibt uns eure Erlebnisse an gyncast@tagesspiegel.de oder über unseren Instagram Account @gyncast.

title: Palabra Libre
description:
En este espacio para el diálogo examinamos la actualidad del país en la etapa terminal del bipartidismo puertorriqueño. Por ello, estamos conscientes tanto de la naturaleza de callejón sin salida de este fin de época, como de su condición de oportunidad colectiva.

Palabra Libre, "Más allá del bipartidismo", reúne a los que ya viven y piensan en el futuro de Puerto Rico.

Conducido por Néstor Duprey Salgado y Eduardo Lalo.

title: De libro en libro
description: ¡Acompáñanos a leer un libro distinto todos los meses! En este proyecto al que a veces llamamos pódcast, Vero y Tere invitan a una persona interesante para discutir alguna lectura… Hayas leído o no, disfruta de una conversación literaria como ninguna otra. Aquí no hay presiones ni juicios, solo disfrute y amistad. ¡Acompáñanos a leer!

title: Bingewatch
description:
The essential podcast for TV addicts, Bingewatch selects and previews the very best films and TV shows for you to watch on UK streaming platforms including Netflix, Amazon Prime, Apple TV, NOW TV, Disney+, Paramount+, and catch-up services such as BBC iPlayer, ITV Hub and All 4.

Journalists Hannah Fernando and Ian MacEwan round up the new releases, bring you the latest news about what’s in production, find out what celebrities like to binge watch, and chew the fat about all things TV-related.

It’s your essential guide through the ever-increasing amount of content available on TV streaming services – so you can spend more time watching, and less time searching!
